sentences.text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a mean BLEU of 28.4 ± 0.6 over 8 seeds, outperforming Varrow-NMT (27.6 ± 0.8) by 0.8 BLEU points.
A paired t-test (n=8, paired by seed) confirmed that this difference is statistically significant (t=3.13, df=7, p=0.017, 95% CI [0.2, 1.44] for the mean paired difference in BLEU).
Tessaline also substantially outperformed the PhraseGrid baseline (22.1 ± 0.8 BLEU) by a significant margin (mean paired difference 6.35 BLEU points, 95% CI [5.87, 6.83], p < 0.001).
